structured.answer: If I do it, I'd do it through Psagot with the fund the page picked, "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)". The page says I'd have about 86,045 ₪ in today's money after 10 years, on 70,000 ₪ put in (10,000 at the start and 500 a month), but I won't do anything until I ask you or the bank. There's a minus next to that fund and I don't know Psagot.

stuck.why: Title says 'להשקיע במדד' and then English buttons (MSCI, S&P 500). To me מדד is the price index, so I nearly felt this page wasn't for me. Only the ת"א-125 button and the line about the 125 companies kept me going.
I don't know where 7% comes from or whether I should change it. The boxes come with sliders, and I left everything as it was, including 10,000 'סכום היום' that I didn't choose.
'−1,030 ₪' with a minus made me back away from that option without understanding it.
'−0.04% בשנה · שנה אחת' with a minus right on the fund it chose for me. I couldn't tell if it means the fund loses money. That's where I stopped.

findings.what: A minus sign next to the recommended fund (−0.04%) with no words explaining it. It scared me off the very fund I was told to choose.
The page opens with English letters and the word מדד without explaining it. Someone like me feels it isn't for her.
The 10,000 starting amount and 7% are filled in already, and the boxes come with sliders. The result depends on numbers I never chose.
Dark background with grey text is hard to read even enlarged
The cost bar uses two oranges and a red that are hard to tell apart
Minus numbers like −1,030 are shown without a sentence saying it's only a difference
Too many numbers per row (remaining, cost, bars, notes). It made me anxious.
Words like דמי משמרת, נאמן, מחקה are never explained
